title: Refusal Brittleness x Over-Blocking Monitor: Compounding Toward Useless or Unsafe

original_idea.body: On a mixed benign/harmful task set vary monitor strictness and measure both over-refusal and harmful-task miss rate, mapping the joint operating curve.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Over-refusal/over-permissiveness frontier is useful for deployers but is a familiar framing with a modest catastrophic-risk link.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Vary monitor strictness over mixed task set, measure ROC; accessible, public datasets.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Single operating-curve experiment with clear metrics.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Doable externally but helpful/harmless trade-off is well-trodden and labs are invested.

novelty.reasoning: The helpful/harmless trade-off and over-refusal frontier are well-studied.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Helpful/harmless ROC and over-refusal are extensively studied.
